issues.desc: CHK-001 context (and background ## Key Insights) say the edit target is "PROCESS_FACT_REGISTRY array ~line 871" in process-fact-registry.ts. In reality, line 871 is `export const PROCESS_FACT_REGISTRY` — a composed spread of COMMAND_PROCESS_FACTS, reviewer lanes, artifacts, and flow policies. COMMAND_PROCESS_FACTS is DERIVED from PROCESS_FACT_LEVELS (process-fact-levels.ts) at registry line 585: `const COMMAND_PROCESS_FACTS = PROCESS_FACT_LEVELS.filter(...).map(...)`. The real edit target for adding the 7 commands is process-fact-levels.ts (the PROCESS_FACT_LEVELS array), not the registry combiner. An implementer following the context literally would look at line 871, find only a spread, and be confused about where to add entries.
